title: CapsuleInvocation
description: One call into one pack. Everything the runner needs and nothing it does not: which pack, which input envelope, which workspace, which authority, what budget. There is no prompt field and no command field - a pack does not get to say what runs, only what it needs, which is the same rule the deterministic-compute-fabric proposal applies to inspectors.

input_envelope_id.description: Null only for the first step of a composition, which is fed by the MissionDefinition itself.

workspace_root.description: One tenant, one mission, one attempt. Never shared, never reused.

lease.description: Authority for this invocation. The pack DECLARES what it needs; this is what it was actually granted, and the two are not the same thing.

target_profile_id.description: Which binding of generic names to concrete tooling applies. Null for packs that need none.
